top_signals.title: AI Startups Rival Private Equity for Talent
top_signals.summary: Private equity is still winning Wall Street's talent war, but the battlefield is shifting. As buyout firms aggressively poach junior bankers, AI startups dangle equity upside and supercharged growth. With AI tools reshaping entry-level roles and payouts at the top swelling again, finance is racing to prove it can still offer the best long-term bet for ambitious young talent. (Source: Bloomberg)
